consensus_summary: The consensus identifies tares as false believers or the wicked, specifically 'the children of the evil one' sown by the devil among true believers, who will be separated and destroyed at the final judgment.
book_summary: The book defines tares as counterfeits mimicking true grain, specifically identifying them as 'the children of the wicked one' who are bound and burned at the harvest.
consensus_core_identification: Children of the evil one / false believers.
book_core_identification: Children of the wicked one / counterfeits.
boundary_disagreement: None. Both adhere strictly to the explicit biblical interpretation in Matthew 13.
rationale: The book's definition perfectly aligns with the consensus, utilizing the exact phrase 'children of the wicked one' from Matthew 13:38 and highlighting the botanical metaphor of a counterfeit weed.
strongest_objection: None. The interpretation relies on explicit decoding provided within the biblical text itself.
